title: Improving Prehospital Stroke Diagnosis Using Natural Language Processing of Paramedic Reports.
summary: NLP of Chicago EMS notes improved held-out stroke identification over one scale; results remain single-region and need further validation. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
